page.content:
Vulcan science officer and first officer.

How Spock connects

  • Creator: Leonard Nimoy — Leonard Nimoy originated Spock.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Original Series — TOS is the series that makes Spock a cultural fixture.
  • Faction: Enterprise crew — Spock is first officer of the TOS Enterprise crew.
  • Location: Vulcan — Spock is a son of Vulcan.
  • Character: James T. Kirk — Kirk's command is built on his bond with Spock.
  • Character: Leonard McCoy — McCoy argues feeling against Spock's logic.

What is Spock?

Spock is the half-Vulcan science officer whose logic, friendship with Kirk, and struggle with emotion are the franchise's longest argument.

Key threads lead to Leonard Nimoy, Star Trek: The Original Series, Enterprise crew, Vulcan, James T. Kirk and Leonard McCoy.
